_note: Empty until practices are onboarded. Two ways to fill this: (1) export from the internal practice database into this file on each deploy, or (2) set window.REBLOOMA.directoryApi in assets/site.js to a live endpoint that returns the same shape, which then takes priority over this file.

_schema.id: string, stable id from the internal database
_schema.name: string, practice name as patients would see it
_schema.setting: one of: clinic | day spa | resort | wellness studio | mobile
_schema.address: string, street address (omit for mobile-only practices)
_schema.lat: number, decimal degrees (optional; enables distance sorting)
_schema.serves: string, e.g. 'Travels within 20 miles of Austin' (mobile practices)
_schema.booking_url: string, absolute URL for online booking (optional)
_schema.accepting: boolean, whether they're taking new Reblooma patients
modalities: string, e.g. deep tissue, prenatal, myofascial
